_note: preview daemon has no macOS TCC permission for ~/Documents — so this serves the /private/tmp/tactics-preview mirror, not the repo. The mirror is refreshed automatically by `python3 scripts/export.py` (it copies site/ wholesale), so no manual copy step is needed. Pages live in site/*.html; data in site/data/*.json. Reloading the browser is enough to pick up new data: site/assets/data.js fetches JSON with cache:'no-store' plus a Date.now() cache-buster (enforced by gate G9). NOTE: this inline handler does not send Cache-Control: no-store — use scripts/serve.sh instead if you need that for HTML/JS too.

configurations.name: heatmap
runtimeArgs: import os,functools;from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer, SimpleHTTPRequestHandler;port=int(os.environ.get('PORT','8123'));H=functools.partial(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory='/private/tmp/tactics-preview');ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',port), H).serve_forever()
